attributes.name: h1 presence and top-level heading level
attributes.definition: Whether the page has an h1 element and, if not, what the highest heading level used is.

values.definition: Page includes an h1 as the top-level heading.
Page lacks an h1; the highest heading level used is h2.
Page lacks an h1 and the top-level heading is something other than h2, or is unspecified.

attributes.name: heading hierarchy depth
attributes.definition: How many levels the heading outline spans and whether levels nest in sequence.

values.definition: Headings nest across three or more levels (e.g. h2 sections with h3 items).

attributes.name: heading markup for non-title text
attributes.definition: Whether non-heading text such as calls to action is marked up as a heading element.

values.definition: A CTA phrase uses a heading tag.
Headings are used only for section or item titles.
